name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index 94 and US 10-year yield back above 5% on 10 Nov after hot CPI; Watch kept by the measured floor
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was near 94 on 10 Nov, little changed on the week, and the US 10-year yield rose to about 5.01% after October CPI came in above forecasts (Yahoo Finance). The yield is about 20bp lower than a month earlier. Both readings sit under the Watch lines (MOVE 100, 40bp a month), but the measured floor keeps Watch until they clear them more decisively.
for_you: US Treasury yields influence mortgage and borrowing costs worldwide, including fixed-rate mortgage pricing in the UK. A 10-year yield near 5% keeps those costs high.
rubric_hit: MOVE 94 < 100 and 10y 1m move 20bp < 40bp; measured floor holds Watch

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index (^MOVE)

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
